review.heading: What GOTCHA learned
review.nothingUsedYet: None of this is in use. GOTCHA only answers from what you approve here - an answer that is still waiting cannot reach a customer.
review.evidenceNotTruth: These are things your team actually said. That makes them evidence, not policy: an agent may have made an exception once, or been wrong.
review.alreadyCoveredBody: You already have an answer for these, so they were not added a second time. Nothing was turned down.
review.evidence: Said {occurrences, plural, one {once} other {# times}} to {customers, plural, one {one customer} other {# customers}}, {from} to {to}.
review.evidenceNoDates: Said {occurrences, plural, one {once} other {# times}} to {customers, plural, one {one customer} other {# customers}}.
review.liveLookup: Do not let the AI state this as fact. It is true in general and depends on something that changes - stock, a calendar, a price - so the AI is told to check before answering rather than promise.

curation.kept: Kept as your team wrote it.
curation.live_data: Marked as needing a live check.

review.conflict: Your team gave more than one answer to this. Choose or write the right one - GOTCHA will not pick for you.
review.duplicateOf: You already have an answer to this in your knowledge base.
review.bulkSafe: This only takes suggestions with no conflict and enough evidence behind them. The list is worked out here, not on this page, so it cannot approve a conflict however it is pressed.
review.rerunSafe: Looking again updates the counts on these suggestions. It does not ask you about anything you have already rejected.
review.noLanguageShortcut: The design offers to add a missing reply language from here. There is nowhere to add one - GOTCHA stores a single language and answers each customer in their own regardless.
